Under this covenant, oil moves only by the steward’s hand. The steward could amend the covenant to welcome visitors — try it.
Refused — even for the steward. The proposal never named the role cell, so the covenant could not see who the steward is. A covenant sees only what a proposal names.

The steward’s role is fixed in this covenant. No one proposes their way into it.
